description: This file defines an internal object for a data migration that converts ID fields from Integer to String types in UserPreferences. It implements the DataMigration interface and provides methods for performing the migration and checking if it is needed.

classes.name: IntToStringIdsMigration
classes.description: An internal singleton object implementing DataMigration to migrate ID fields from Int to String in UserPreferences.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations if necessary; here it does nothing.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Performs the migration of IDs from Int to String in UserPreferences.

methods.name: shouldMigrate
methods.description: Determines whether the migration should be performed based on the current data.
